semantics.set_true: Queued only, not an acknowledgement; may be cancelled before dispatch/retry.
semantics.freshness: Feature-local trusted C0; age <= maxAge milliseconds, using uint32_t elapsed time.
semantics.callback: Every trusted C0 handled by normal query/control/display response parsing, including unchanged and opposite-to-request values; no callback on registration or malformed C0.
semantics.snapshot: Separate from ordinary climate cache; malformed C0 invalidates freshness; newer C0 supersedes queued writes.
semantics.writes: Explicit only; no optimistic changes, startup/reconnect/restore commands, or automatic busy-command replay.
semantics.guard: Check freshness and snapshot revision before dispatch and each retry; cancellation releases the busy-control flag.
semantics.ordinary_climate: Existing callbacks/control semantics retained, including busy control drop behavior.

integration.restore_mode: Do not send a saved state on startup/reconnection.
integration.public_esphome_access: Not established; follow-up must verify the actual ESPHome parent API.

scope.hardware_evidence: One Midea-compatible AC with an ESP8266 UART adapter; ON/OFF and physical remote feedback.
scope.short_legacy_formats: Synthetic host coverage only, not hardware confirmation.
scope.global_climate_validation: Out of scope; separate open proposal #50. A minimal memcpy bound is included.
scope.busy_climate_replay: Out of scope; separate open proposal #48.
